## Primary Capabilities & Project Focus
- **B2B Export Platform Concepts**: Founder-led trade presentation, product categorization, origin storytelling, export-readiness framework, and conceptual trade simulations.
- **Community Information Portals**: Neighborhood announcements, committee directories, financial summaries, and local business marketplaces.
- **High-Density SaaS Dashboards**: Operational management interfaces aggregating telemetry, inventory counts, and sales analytics.
- **Public Information Hubs**: Responsive community & mosque information portals featuring prayer schedules, programs, donation guides, and published financial reports.

## Core Projects
- **Origin Of Indonesia (OOI)**: Founder-Led Product — Active Prototype for B2B Indonesian origin export presentation.
- **CGV10 Portal Warga**: Community Information Portal for Cipta Greenville RT 010/RW 021.
- **OneEcos SaaS Cockpit**: High-density operational management dashboard concept.
- **Masjid Al-Ikhlas Digital Presence**: Live community information website for Masjid Al Ikhlas Cipta Greenville.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend & Web**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
- **Data & Foundation**: Supabase, Responsive Web Design, Netlify, Vercel, GitHub
